title: Dimensional Decomposition and Column Generation for Bin Dimensioning in E-Commerce Fulfillment Centers
summary: A fulfillment center (FC) is a specialized logistics facility where e-commerce inventory is received, stored, and processed. Its internal organization directly impacts space utilization and the performance of put-away and picking operations.
